name: Paris
description: The City of Light — world-renowned for the Eiffel Tower, Louvre Museum, charming cafés, and timeless romance along the Seine.

activities.name: Eiffel Tower Visit
activities.description: Ascend the iconic iron tower for panoramic views of Paris from the summit.

activities.name: Louvre Museum Tour
activities.description: Explore the world's largest art museum, home to the Mona Lisa and Venus de Milo.

activities.name: Seine River Cruise
activities.description: Glide past Notre-Dame, the Musée d'Orsay, and illuminated bridges on a scenic boat ride.

activities.name: Montmartre Walking Tour
activities.description: Stroll through the artistic hilltop neighborhood, visit Sacré-Cœur, and enjoy street performers.

activities.name: French Pastry Workshop
activities.description: Learn to make croissants and macarons from a professional Parisian pâtissier.

name: Tokyo
description: A dazzling metropolis where ancient temples sit beside neon-lit skyscrapers, offering unmatched cuisine, technology, and culture.

activities.name: Senso-ji Temple Visit
activities.description: Walk through the iconic Thunder Gate to Tokyo's oldest and most significant Buddhist temple.

activities.name: Shibuya Crossing Experience
activities.description: Stand at the world's busiest pedestrian crossing and feel the pulse of Tokyo's energy.

activities.name: Tsukiji Outer Market Food Tour
activities.description: Sample the freshest sushi, tamagoyaki, and street food at Tokyo's legendary fish market area.

activities.name: TeamLab Borderless
activities.description: Immerse yourself in a boundary-less digital art museum with interactive light installations.

activities.name: Akihabara Tech District
activities.description: Explore the electric town — multi-story anime shops, retro arcades, and cutting-edge electronics.

name: New York City
description: The city that never sleeps — Broadway shows, Central Park, world-class museums, and a skyline that defines urban ambition.

activities.name: Statue of Liberty & Ellis Island
activities.description: Ferry to Liberty Island and explore the immigration museum that shaped America.

activities.name: Central Park Walk
activities.description: Wander through 843 acres of lakes, meadows, and woodlands in the heart of Manhattan.

activities.name: Broadway Show
activities.description: Catch a world-famous theatrical performance in the Theater District.

activities.name: Metropolitan Museum of Art
activities.description: Explore over 5,000 years of art across 2 million square feet of gallery space.

activities.name: Brooklyn Bridge Walk
activities.description: Walk across the iconic 1883 bridge for stunning views of the Manhattan skyline.

name: Bali
description: Island of the Gods — lush rice terraces, sacred temples, surfing beaches, and a spiritual atmosphere unlike anywhere else.

activities.name: Tegallalang Rice Terraces
activities.description: Walk among dramatic cascading rice paddies with a lush jungle backdrop.

activities.name: Uluwatu Temple Sunset
activities.description: Watch a Kecak fire dance performance as the sun sets over the Indian Ocean cliff temple.

activities.name: Surfing at Kuta Beach
activities.description: Catch waves at one of the world's most famous beginner-friendly surf spots.

activities.name: Ubud Monkey Forest
activities.description: Walk through a sacred sanctuary of Balinese long-tailed macaques amid ancient temples.

activities.name: Balinese Cooking Class
activities.description: Visit a local market, learn traditional spice blending, and cook an authentic Balinese feast.

name: Rome
description: The Eternal City — 2,500 years of art, architecture, and cuisine condensed into one walkable, breathtaking destination.

activities.name: Colosseum Tour
activities.description: Step inside the ancient amphitheater that once hosted gladiator battles and public spectacles.

activities.name: Vatican Museums & Sistine Chapel
activities.description: Marvel at Michelangelo's ceiling masterpiece and centuries of papal art collections.

activities.name: Trastevere Food Walk
activities.description: Taste authentic Roman street food — supplì, pizza al taglio, and gelato in the liveliest neighborhood.

activities.name: Trevi Fountain & Spanish Steps
activities.description: Toss a coin in the Baroque fountain and climb the famous staircase for city views.

activities.name: Pantheon Visit
activities.description: Enter the best-preserved building of ancient Rome, crowned by its legendary concrete dome.

name: Dubai
description: A futuristic desert oasis — record-breaking skyscrapers, luxury shopping, golden sand dunes, and year-round sunshine.

activities.name: Burj Khalifa Observation Deck
activities.description: Rise to the 148th floor of the world's tallest building for views stretching to the horizon.

activities.name: Desert Safari with BBQ Dinner
activities.description: Ride dunes in a 4x4, try sandboarding, watch a belly dance show, and feast under the stars.

activities.name: Dubai Mall & Aquarium
activities.description: Shop in the world's largest mall and walk through a tunnel surrounded by sharks and rays.

activities.name: Old Dubai Heritage Walk
activities.description: Cross Dubai Creek by abra boat, explore the Gold Souk, and visit the Dubai Museum.

activities.name: Dhow Cruise Dinner
activities.description: Dine on a traditional wooden dhow as it glides past the illuminated Dubai Marina skyline.

name: Barcelona
description: Gaudí's playground — a vibrant coastal city where gothic architecture, Mediterranean beaches, and Catalan culture converge.

activities.name: Sagrada Familia Tour
activities.description: Explore Gaudí's unfinished masterpiece — a basilica that has been under construction since 1882.

activities.name: Park Güell
activities.description: Wander through colorful mosaic terraces and whimsical structures with city-wide views.

activities.name: La Boqueria Market
activities.description: Browse stalls of fresh seafood, tropical fruit, and tapas in Barcelona's most famous market.

activities.name: Gothic Quarter Walk
activities.description: Lose yourself in medieval alleyways, hidden squares, and 2,000-year-old Roman walls.

activities.name: Barceloneta Beach
activities.description: Relax on golden sand, swim in the Mediterranean, and enjoy chiringuito beach bars.

name: Cape Town
description: Where mountains meet the ocean — Table Mountain, penguins, wine valleys, and a cultural melting pot at Africa's southern tip.

activities.name: Table Mountain Cable Car
activities.description: Ride a rotating cable car to the flat summit for 360-degree views of the city, ocean, and Robben Island.

activities.name: Boulders Beach Penguins
activities.description: Walk among a colony of endangered African penguins on sheltered granite boulder beaches.

activities.name: Cape Winelands Tour
activities.description: Taste world-class wines at estates in Stellenbosch and Franschhoek, set among dramatic mountains.

activities.name: Robben Island Tour
activities.description: Visit the prison where Nelson Mandela was held, guided by a former political prisoner.

activities.name: Shark Cage Diving
activities.description: Come face-to-face with great white sharks in the waters off Gansbaai, the shark capital of the world.

name: Bangkok
description: A sensory overload — ornate shrines, bustling floating markets, fiery street food, and a nightlife that never stops.

activities.name: Grand Palace & Wat Phra Kaew
activities.description: Tour the former royal residence and Thailand's most sacred temple housing the Emerald Buddha.

activities.name: Chatuchak Weekend Market
activities.description: Navigate 15,000 stalls across one of the world's largest outdoor markets.

activities.name: Street Food Tour (Yaowarat)
activities.description: Eat your way through Bangkok's Chinatown — grilled seafood, pad thai, mango sticky rice, and more.

activities.name: Floating Market Day Trip
activities.description: Paddle through canal markets where vendors sell fruit, noodles, and souvenirs from long-tail boats.

activities.name: Muay Thai Match
activities.description: Watch Thailand's national sport live at Rajadamnern Stadium — electric atmosphere guaranteed.

name: Istanbul
description: Where East meets West — a city straddling two continents, layered with Ottoman palaces, Byzantine mosaics, and vibrant bazaars.

activities.name: Hagia Sophia
activities.description: Enter the 1,500-year-old architectural marvel that served as a cathedral, mosque, and museum.

activities.name: Grand Bazaar Shopping
activities.description: Haggle for ceramics, spices, lanterns, and carpets in one of the world's oldest covered markets.

activities.name: Bosphorus Strait Cruise
activities.description: Sail between Europe and Asia, passing Ottoman waterfront mansions and medieval fortresses.

activities.name: Turkish Bath (Hamam)
activities.description: Experience a centuries-old bathing ritual — steam rooms, exfoliating scrub, and foam massage.

activities.name: Street Food Crawl
activities.description: Taste balık ekmek (fish sandwich), simit, roasted chestnuts, and Turkish tea by the waterfront.

name: Sydney
description: Harbor city icon — the Opera House, golden beaches, lush botanical gardens, and a laid-back outdoor lifestyle year round.

activities.name: Sydney Opera House Tour
activities.description: Go behind the scenes of the sail-shaped masterpiece — one of the 20th century's greatest buildings.

activities.name: Bondi to Coogee Coastal Walk
activities.description: Hike 6 km of dramatic coastline passing cliffs, bays, and ocean pools between iconic beaches.

activities.name: Harbour Bridge Climb
activities.description: Climb to the summit of the bridge for unmatched panoramic views of the harbor and city.

activities.name: Taronga Zoo Ferry Visit
activities.description: Ferry across the harbor to a world-class zoo with Australian wildlife and skyline views.

activities.name: The Rocks Markets & History
activities.description: Browse weekend markets and colonial-era laneways in Sydney's oldest neighborhood.

name: Marrakech
description: A feast for the senses — fragrant spice souks, intricate tile work, rooftop terraces overlooking the Atlas Mountains.

activities.name: Jemaa el-Fnaa Square
activities.description: Experience the legendary square — snake charmers, musicians, henna artists, and sizzling food stalls.

activities.name: Bahia Palace Tour
activities.description: Admire the stunning 19th-century palace with intricate zellige tilework and painted cedar ceilings.

activities.name: Atlas Mountains Day Hike
activities.description: Trek through Berber villages and river valleys with views of North Africa's highest peaks.

activities.name: Moroccan Cooking Class
activities.description: Shop for spices, then cook tagine, couscous, and mint tea in a traditional riad kitchen.

activities.name: Souk Shopping Experience
activities.description: Navigate labyrinthine alleys of leather, ceramics, lanterns, and handwoven textiles.
